# Mikhail Semenov, Product Manager

Product manager in B2B SaaS at Zvonobot (Prof-IT Group). Launched the voice AI agent
line from zero in the fall of 2025: 80 paying B2B customers and 500,000+ minutes of
live conversations in production in under a year. Owns pricing, unit economics and
go-to-market; prototypes with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) so hypotheses get
tested in days.

## Role and focus
- Title: Product Manager (B2B SaaS, voice AI agents, LLM)
- Company: Zvonobot, Prof-IT Group (since February 2022); launched and runs the AI agent line since fall 2025
- Team: 4 engineers; a sales team that grew from 4 to 15 to sell the line
- Open to: Product Manager roles in B2B SaaS, payments and AI products
- Languages: Russian (native), English (working proficiency, comfortable in written and async)
- Work format: remote, GMT+5, open to relocation

## Selected work
- Zvonobot AI: voice AI-agent platform for B2B (Prof-IT), launched in the fall of 2025 and owned end-to-end (product, pricing, go-to-market). Multi-tenant SaaS console over telephony infrastructure. Case: https://rebsem.ru/projects/zvonobot-ai-en/
- cursivo: AI-powered CRM for car rental, led from product logic to release. https://cursivo.xyz
- obrabot: internal voice AI analytics dashboard (Prof-IT). Case: https://rebsem.ru/projects/obrabot-en/
- Side projects shipped in 1-7 days with AI coding agents (bazabot, Zodial, Slopiq, portfo)

## Skills
Product: product strategy, roadmap, discovery, customer interviews, metrics and unit economics, pricing, A/B experiments, go-to-market, B2B SaaS, CRM.
AI / LLM: voice AI agents, conversational AI, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, RAG, LLM evals, ASR, TTS, contact centers, SIP telephony.
Delivery: spec, review, release cycle; prototyping with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex); fast hypothesis validation, 0 to 1.
Shared language with engineers: TypeScript, Python, SQL, REST, telephony.
